parameters.query:
WITH approved(entity_key) AS (
    VALUES
      ('crm.sales_reps'::text),
      ('crm.accounts'),
      ('crm.contacts'),
      ('crm.deals'),
      ('crm.activities'),
      ('marketing.campaigns'),
      ('marketing.leads'),
      ('billing.invoices'),
      ('billing.payments'),
      ('planning.sales_targets')
)
SELECT
    COUNT(cp.entity_key)::INTEGER AS checkpoint_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE cp.checkpoint_status = 'ready'
          AND cp.claimed_run_id IS NULL
    )::INTEGER AS ready_checkpoint_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM ingestion.sync_runs WHERE run_status = 'running') AS active_run_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM ingestion.sync_run_entities WHERE entity_status = 'running') AS active_entity_run_count,
    (
        COUNT(cp.entity_key) = 10
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.checkpoint_status = 'ready' AND cp.claimed_run_id IS NULL) = 10
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ingestion.sync_runs WHERE run_status = 'running') = 0
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ingestion.sync_run_entities WHERE entity_status = 'running') = 0
    ) AS batch_checkpoint_verified,
    'full_sync_checkpoint_verification_complete'::TEXT AS workflow_stage
FROM approved a
LEFT JOIN ingestion.sync_checkpoints cp ON cp.entity_key = a.entity_key;

parameters.query:
BEGIN;

CALL transformation.refresh_reporting();

DO $lumora_validate$
DECLARE
    v_raw_deals              INTEGER;
    v_reporting_deals        INTEGER;
    v_rejections             INTEGER;
    v_orphan_reporting       INTEGER;
    v_value_mismatches       INTEGER;
BEGIN

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
    INTO v_raw_deals
    FROM raw_crm.deals;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
    INTO v_reporting_deals
    FROM reporting.fact_deals;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
    INTO v_rejections
    FROM quality.transformation_rejections;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- COVERAGE VALIDATION
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    IF v_raw_deals <> (v_reporting_deals + v_rejections) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'REPORTING_REFRESH_COVERAGE_FAILED | raw=% | reporting=% | rejected=%',
            v_raw_deals,
            v_reporting_deals,
            v_rejections;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- ORPHAN VALIDATION
    -- No reporting deal may exist without a raw source deal.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
    INTO v_orphan_reporting
    FROM reporting.fact_deals f

    LEFT JOIN raw_crm.deals r
        ON r.deal_id = f.deal_id

    WHERE r.deal_id IS NULL;


    IF v_orphan_reporting <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'REPORTING_REFRESH_ORPHAN_FAILED | orphan_reporting_deals=%',
            v_orphan_reporting;
    END IF;


    -- --------------------------------------------------------
    -- VALUE ALIGNMENT VALIDATION
    -- Verify important fields shared by raw and reporting.
    -- --------------------------------------------------------

    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
    INTO v_value_mismatches

    FROM raw_crm.deals r

    JOIN reporting.fact_deals f
        ON f.deal_id = r.deal_id

    WHERE
           r.amount
               IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount

        OR r.stage
               IS DISTINCT FROM f.stage

        OR r.outcome
               IS DISTINCT FROM f.outcome

        OR r.expected_close_date
               IS DISTINCT FROM f.expected_close_date;


    IF v_value_mismatches <> 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'REPORTING_REFRESH_VALUE_ALIGNMENT_FAILED | mismatches=%',
            v_value_mismatches;
    END IF;

END;
$lumora_validate$;

COMMIT;


SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
     FROM raw_crm.deals)
        AS raw_deal_count,

    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
     FROM reporting.fact_deals)
        AS reporting_deal_count,

    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
     FROM quality.transformation_rejections)
        AS transformation_rejections,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM raw_crm.deals r

        JOIN reporting.fact_deals f
            ON f.deal_id = r.deal_id

        WHERE
               r.amount
                   IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount

            OR r.stage
                   IS DISTINCT FROM f.stage

            OR r.outcome
                   IS DISTINCT FROM f.outcome

            OR r.expected_close_date
                   IS DISTINCT FROM f.expected_close_date
    ) AS value_mismatch_count,

    (
        SELECT amount::NUMERIC(14,2)
        FROM reporting.fact_deals
        WHERE deal_id = 'DL0392'
    ) AS dl0392_reporting_amount,

    (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                SUM(amount),
                0
            )::NUMERIC(14,2)

        FROM reporting.fact_deals
        WHERE outcome IS NULL
    ) AS all_open_pipeline,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM reporting.fact_deals
        WHERE outcome IS NULL
    ) AS open_deals,

    TRUE AS reporting_refresh_valid,

    'reporting_refresh_committed'::TEXT
        AS workflow_stage;

nodes.name: MSYNC-008 | Refresh Reporting Once
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
MSYNC-008

NODE NAME
MSYNC-008 | Refresh Reporting Once

NODE TYPE
Postgres — Execute Query

STAGE
Stage 8 — Transactional Reporting Refresh

PURPOSE
Refreshes the governed Lumora reporting and quality layers from the successfully synchronized raw source layer.

RESPONSIBILITY
Calls the approved transformation.refresh_reporting() database procedure.

Runs post-transformation integrity validation inside the same PostgreSQL transaction.

Commits the reporting refresh only when the transformation and validation both succeed.

DATABASE CREDENTIAL
LUMORA | Transform RW

DATABASE
lumora_revenue_simulation

AUTHORIZED DATABASE SCOPE
READ:
raw_crm
raw_marketing
raw_billing
raw_planning

WRITE:
reporting
quality

NO ACCESS:
ingestion
control
audit

TRANSACTION CONTRACT
BEGIN
→ CALL transformation.refresh_reporting()
→ validate coverage
→ validate orphan reporting rows
→ validate important raw/reporting values
→ COMMIT

If the procedure or any validation fails, PostgreSQL raises an exception and the transaction is rolled back.

VALIDATION CONTRACT
Raw deal count must equal:
reporting fact deal count + transformation rejection count.

No reporting deal may exist without a corresponding raw deal.

For represented deals, these fields must match raw:
amount
stage
outcome
expected_close_date

RECOVERY CONTRACT
This node runs once only after the parent proves all ten entity workers completed successfully and every checkpoint is released.

Therefore a later no-change execution can repair a previously stale reporting layer without requiring another source-system change.

SECURITY BOUNDARY
The node executes one fixed database-controlled transformation contract.

Manager input cannot select SQL, schema, table, procedure, or credential.

The credential cannot write raw source data.

The credential cannot read or modify ingestion, governance, or audit domains.

NO AI
NO ARBITRARY SQL
NO SOURCE DATABASE ACCESS
NO RAW WRITE
NO INGESTION ACCESS
NO GOVERNANCE ACCESS
NO AUDIT ACCESS
NO SECRET IN NODE NOTES

STATUS
Stage 8H parent-orchestrator runtime verification pending.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS reporting_deal_count,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE outcome IS NULL
    )::INTEGER AS open_deals,

    COALESCE(
        SUM(amount) FILTER (
            WHERE outcome IS NULL
        ),
        0
    )::NUMERIC(14,2) AS all_open_pipeline,

    (
        SELECT amount::NUMERIC(14,2)
        FROM reporting.fact_deals
        WHERE deal_id = 'DL0392'
    ) AS dl0392_reporting_amount,

    (
        COUNT(*) = 600
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IS NULL) = 190

        AND COALESCE(
            SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE outcome IS NULL),
            0
        ) = 2902000.00::NUMERIC

        AND (
            SELECT amount
            FROM reporting.fact_deals
            WHERE deal_id = 'DL0392'
        ) = 8500.00::NUMERIC
    ) AS reporting_ro_verified,

    'reporting_ro_verification_complete'::TEXT
        AS workflow_stage

FROM reporting.fact_deals;
